notes.title: Update notes for 1.1.2
notes.content:
Update notes for 1.1.2
- Fixed some mismatched Room decoration icons
- Some balancing to facilities unlocking requirements
- Added total number of checked-in Customers to the Facilities screen
- Some visual improvements to Facilities screen

notes.title: Room Decoration and Radio Update is out
notes.content:
Update notes for 2025/03/27 - 1.1.0 - "Room Decoration and Radio Update"
- Added a radio to the reception desk/counter, so you can listen to musics while playing
- Now you can customize the Room's walls, floor and ceiling 
- Added a max FPS counter to the Settings
- Added icon above customer (on the Bar) to show which drink he wants
- Fixed the Eating area's food boards data sometimes is incorrectly saved
- Fixed some edge cases where the Customer could not be interacted with at the Bar
- Made it not possible to "reset" a Eating area food placement board by adding a different type of food
- Improved animation transition after the Customer finishes sitting on the Swimming Pool's lounge chair
- Some buttons that are disabled now change cursor and are displayed as "flat"
- Fixed Customers in some situations can not "detect" that there's food on the Eating area
- Upgraded to Godot game engine v4.4.1
- Some facilities unlocks balancing
- Other minor fixes

notes.title: Update notes for 2025/03/19
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

In this update we focused on making the start of the game easier and less repetitive

Here are the changes we made:
- Added button to automatically clean all the rooms by paying an amount per room (40% of per day room's income) - It's in the Rooms management screen
- Reduced the cost of unlocking facilities and rooms
- Fixed situations where the customer would only visit one Facility per day
- Fixed bug with some cases where the Unlock lifeguard facility button on the Facilities screen should have been enabled
- Fixed some translations not being correctly translated

notes.title: Little resort simulator is out now!
notes.content:
Little resort simulator (v1.0) has been released on Steam.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45359324/30ab0dc9e537ee3213120adce25d180af5067b36.jpg

It includes:
* Unlocking and modifying customer's rooms
* Cleaning the customer's rooms
* The Bar where you can serve drinks to the customers
* The Eating area where you serve food to the customers
* The Swimming pool where the customers can spend time to relax
* The Massage parlor where you can give massages to the customers
* The Lifeguard buoy allows you to throw it at the customers that are having trouble swimming in the ocean

Note: We also updated the Store page, with a up to date trailer (and screenshots) will all the facilities and things you can do in the game.

Hope you have fun!
